description: Repairs r-err-1b/con-pk-duplicate-insert: the INSERT ran through Database.Execute without dbFailOnError (128) and the table was never read back, so the record cannot say whether ACE refused the row, skipped it silently or accepted it. P holds a row with ID 1 under primary key PK_P. Errors read; every row of P read through a snapshot (the baseline); Database.Execute of "INSERT INTO P (ID, Code, Req) VALUES (1, 'x1', 'r')" with Options dbFailOnError (128); Errors read; RecordsAffected read; every row of P read through a new snapshot. Asks whether the row is refused, skipped or accepted, the Number and message, and what the table holds afterwards. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
